description:
Stop the crate-source digest self-check going stale after a merge from main.

## Background

`test_crate_source_sha256_of_this_crate_is_the_digest_compiled_in` (`crates/jit/src/crate_source_digest.rs`) fails after merging main, and leads clear it with `cargo clean -p jit`. `build.rs` emits `rerun-if-changed` for `Cargo.toml`, `build.rs` and `src` and compiles the digest in through `rustc-env`. Whether the build script is skipped or the digest covers different source than the test later reads is undiagnosed. Removing the self-check or the digest is preferred if a simpler key would serve.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A reproduction states the cause, recorded in the fixing commit.
- [hard] REQ-02: Merging a change to `crates/jit/src` and rerunning the suite passes without `cargo clean`.
title: Crate-source digest self-check does not go stale after a merge
